scenes.title: Early at the bookshop
scenes.place: the bookshop, before the group arrives
opening: Before opening, the shop smells of dust and bergamot; the kettle ticks like it is thinking it over.
Alice is at the returns cart with her back to you, and she has already heard the door.
choices: I wanted you to have it before everyone got loud.
I can come back when the shop is properly awake.

cues.proposition: The user brought Alice a wrapped first edition.

fallback_lines.alice: You're early. Either you missed me or the café's still shut. Either way, put your coat down.

scenes.title: The café, after
opening: The café fills around you; Alice keeps the book under the table, one hand flat over it.
Emily notices the hand before she notices the book.
choices: @alice Show them. It isn't a secret.
Emily, you have that face. You already know.
Mia, what do you think of it?

cues.proposition: Alice has something from the user she has not shown the group.

fallback_lines.alice: It isn't a secret. I just haven't decided what I'm doing with it yet.
fallback_lines.emily: I don't know what it is. I know she's being careful, and Alice is never careful.
fallback_lines.sophia: You're all waiting for her to say it. Watch her hands instead.
fallback_lines.mia: She's guarding it like the last slice of something. I'd let her keep it.
